target.statement: ActiveSetPageRank (Algorithm 1) returns an ACL ε-approximate PageRank vector with support volume ≤ 2/ε, matching the theoretical eO(1/√(αε)) bound; a concrete check is that the returned vector satisfies the ACL residue condition 0 ≤ r ≤ εd and support volume ≤ 2/ε on a small graph.
target.dataset: any small undirected graph (e.g., a synthetic or standard SNAP graph) with a chosen seed, α, ε

compute.basis: No code is released; the target requires implementing Algorithm 1 plus a working SDD solver (e.g., a Laplacian/PCG or combinatorial solver) from scratch, then validating the ACL residue/support-volume guarantee on a small graph — feasible on CPU but the SDD solver and correctness checks are the main effort.

blockers: No code or data links in the paper
Requires implementing an SDD linear-system solver as a black box
Theoretical result only; no empirical benchmark to reproduce
title: Accelerating the Local Push Primitive for PageRank Computation
